t: You're looking at The Mother and the Child, a sculpture by the British artist Helen Sinclair. Sinclair made this piece, and that is what ties her to this spot. The title tells you the subject: a mother and her child. Take a moment to walk around it and see how the two figures relate to one another. I don't have more detail about when it was made or what it's carved or cast from, so let the work speak for itself, and notice what it makes you feel.
